description: Precious metals term structure and execution-quality analytics on QuestDB. Real COMEX contract months for the gold and silver strips; counterparty and venue markout built on HORIZON JOIN.

panels.description: Live mid price for the gold strip. Each leg is anchored to the real listed COMEX contract month resolved at startup (front, ~6M, ~12M), so the spacing between the lines is the actual market carry, not a synthetic offset. Gold trades in contango: the deferred months sit above the front.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT timestamp AS time,
       avg(CASE WHEN symbol = 'GC'   THEN (best_bid + best_ask) / 2 END) AS gold_front,
       avg(CASE WHEN symbol = 'GC6'  THEN (best_bid + best_ask) / 2 END) AS gold_6m,
       avg(CASE WHEN symbol = 'GC12' THEN (best_bid + best_ask) / 2 END) AS gold_12m
FROM commodities_market_data
WHERE $__timeFilter(timestamp) AND symbol IN ('GC', 'GC6', 'GC12')
SAMPLE BY $__interval

panels.title: Gold Forward Curve - Front vs 6M vs 12M

panels.description: Latest mid for each anchored contract month. Gold's deferred months are ABOVE the front (contango, the cost of carry). Crude's are BELOW it (backwardation, front-month tightness). Both shapes come from live prices.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT symbol,
       (last(best_bid) + last(best_ask)) / 2 AS mid,
       last(best_ask) - last(best_bid)       AS spread
FROM commodities_market_data
WHERE $__timeFilter(timestamp)
  AND symbol IN ('GC', 'GC6', 'GC12', 'SI', 'SI12', 'CL', 'CL12')
GROUP BY symbol

panels.title: Curve Snapshot - Contango vs Backwardation

panels.description: The gold carry in dollars per ounce, via ASOF JOIN of the two legs onto a common 1s grid. Positive and widening means the forward premium is growing.

targets.rawSql:
WITH front AS (
  SELECT timestamp, (best_bid + best_ask) / 2 AS mid
  FROM commodities_bbo_1s
  WHERE symbol = 'GC' AND $__timeFilter(timestamp)
), deferred AS (
  SELECT timestamp, (best_bid + best_ask) / 2 AS mid
  FROM commodities_bbo_1s
  WHERE symbol = 'GC12' AND $__timeFilter(timestamp)
)
SELECT front.timestamp AS time,
       deferred.mid - front.mid AS gold_12m_basis
FROM front ASOF JOIN deferred

panels.title: Gold 12M Basis (GC12 - GC)
Execution Quality - Who Is Picking Us Off

panels.description: Every fill paired with the mid 60 seconds later via HORIZON JOIN, then averaged per counterparty. Markout is signed FROM THE COUNTERPARTY'S SIDE: red means the market moved their way after they traded and we were adversely selected; green means we internalised profitable flow. One query, no pre-aggregation, over the full trade history.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT t.counterparty,
       count()      AS fills,
       sum(t.size)  AS lots,
       avg(CASE WHEN t.side = 'B' THEN ((m.best_bid + m.best_ask) / 2 - t.price) / t.price * 10000 ELSE (t.price - (m.best_bid + m.best_ask) / 2) / t.price * 10000 END) AS markout_60s_bps
FROM commodities_trades t
HORIZON JOIN commodities_market_data m ON (symbol) LIST (60s) AS h
WHERE $__timeFilter(t.timestamp)
GROUP BY t.counterparty
ORDER BY markout_60s_bps DESC

panels.title: Counterparty Scorecard - 60s Markout

panels.description: The same markout computed at a grid of horizons in a single HORIZON JOIN pass. Informed flow starts NEGATIVE (they cross the spread to get filled) and turns sharply positive as their information plays out. Hedger flow just keeps decaying in our favour. The peak marks where their edge is exhausted. X axis is seconds after the fill, not wall-clock time.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT h.offset / 1000000000 AS horizon_s,
       avg(CASE WHEN t.counterparty = 'HFT_ARB_01' THEN
           CASE WHEN t.side = 'B' THEN ((m.best_bid + m.best_ask) / 2 - t.price) / t.price * 10000 ELSE (t.price - (m.best_bid + m.best_ask) / 2) / t.price * 10000 END END) AS hft_arb_01,
       avg(CASE WHEN t.counterparty = 'MACRO_FUND_01' THEN
           CASE WHEN t.side = 'B' THEN ((m.best_bid + m.best_ask) / 2 - t.price) / t.price * 10000 ELSE (t.price - (m.best_bid + m.best_ask) / 2) / t.price * 10000 END END) AS macro_fund_01,
       avg(CASE WHEN t.counterparty = 'BANK_TIER1_03' THEN
           CASE WHEN t.side = 'B' THEN ((m.best_bid + m.best_ask) / 2 - t.price) / t.price * 10000 ELSE (t.price - (m.best_bid + m.best_ask) / 2) / t.price * 10000 END END) AS bank_tier1_03,
       avg(CASE WHEN t.counterparty = 'MINER_01' THEN
           CASE WHEN t.side = 'B' THEN ((m.best_bid + m.best_ask) / 2 - t.price) / t.price * 10000 ELSE (t.price - (m.best_bid + m.best_ask) / 2) / t.price * 10000 END END) AS miner_01
FROM commodities_trades t
HORIZON JOIN commodities_market_data m ON (symbol)
     LIST (1s, 5s, 10s, 30s, 1m, 2m, 5m) AS h
WHERE $__timeFilter(t.timestamp)
GROUP BY horizon_s
ORDER BY horizon_s

panels.title: Markout Decay Curve - Sharpest vs Most Benign Flow

panels.description: Per-venue execution cost for the selected symbol only. Venue must be compared WITHIN an instrument: screen venues carry the instruments their exchange lists, so a cross-instrument venue average measures the product mix, not the venue. Effective spread is distance from mid at fill time.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT t.venue,
       count() AS fills,
       avg(abs(t.price - (m.best_bid + m.best_ask) / 2)
           / ((m.best_bid + m.best_ask) / 2) * 10000) AS eff_spread_bps,
       avg(CASE WHEN t.passive THEN 1.0 ELSE 0.0 END) AS passive_rate
FROM commodities_trades t
ASOF JOIN commodities_market_data m ON (symbol)
WHERE $__timeFilter(t.timestamp) AND t.symbol = '${SYMBOL}'
GROUP BY t.venue
ORDER BY eff_spread_bps

panels.title: Venue Scorecard - ${SYMBOL}

panels.description: What crossing the spread actually costs. Passive fills rest and get taken; aggressive fills pay to get done. The gap is the price of immediacy.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT t.passive,
       count() AS fills,
       avg(abs(t.price - (m.best_bid + m.best_ask) / 2)
           / ((m.best_bid + m.best_ask) / 2) * 10000) AS eff_spread_bps
FROM commodities_trades t
ASOF JOIN commodities_market_data m ON (symbol)
WHERE $__timeFilter(t.timestamp) AND t.symbol = '${SYMBOL}'
GROUP BY t.passive

panels.title: Passive vs Aggressive Fill Cost - ${SYMBOL}

panels.description: QuestDB's native vwap(price, size) and twap(price, timestamp) aggregates. TWAP weights every interval equally via step-function integration; VWAP weights by size. They diverge exactly when volume clusters, which is when the choice of benchmark changes what a fill is judged against.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT timestamp AS time,
       vwap(price, size)      AS vwap,
       twap(price, timestamp) AS twap,
       last(price)            AS last_price,
       (vwap(price, size) - twap(price, timestamp))
           / twap(price, timestamp) * 10000 AS vwap_minus_twap_bps
FROM commodities_trades
WHERE $__timeFilter(timestamp) AND symbol = '${SYMBOL}'
SAMPLE BY $__interval

panels.title: VWAP vs TWAP vs Last - ${SYMBOL}

panels.description: Traded OHLC bars for the selected symbol.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT timestamp AS time,
       first(price) AS open, max(price) AS high,
       min(price) AS low, last(price) AS close,
       sum(size) AS volume
FROM commodities_trades
WHERE $__timeFilter(timestamp) AND symbol = '${SYMBOL}'
SAMPLE BY $__interval

panels.title: OHLC + Volume - ${SYMBOL}

panels.description: Visualizes the order book snapshot for the selected commodity, showing the price and cumulative volume at each bid and ask level. The area under the green (bids) and red (asks) lines represents market liquidity on both sides, with the mid-price and top volume walls highlighted.

targets.rawSql:
WITH snapshot AS (
  SELECT timestamp, bids, asks
  FROM commodities_market_data
  WHERE $__timeFilter(timestamp) AND symbol = '${SYMBOL}'
  ORDER BY timestamp DESC
  LIMIT 1
)
SELECT timestamp, bids[1] as bprices, bids[2] as bvolumes, array_cum_sum(bids[2]) as bcumvolumes, asks[1] as aprices, asks[2] as avolumes, array_cum_sum(asks[2]) as acumvolumes FROM snapshot;
